observations: Four main channels are mutually exclusive with the Tube Driver path.
T.D. EQ is associated with the Tube Driver path; no independent Driver gain is documented.
Gain Boost, Mid Shift and Bright belong to Clean/Crunch; Hi Gain, Contour and Mid Edge belong to Lead I/II.
Modern/Classic and Mega Lo Punch apply to the four main channels, while Presence A/B, Master A/B and Depth Boost are power/output functions.
